description: List MGnify's controlled biome vocabulary — the ~492 colon-delimited lineages (root:Host-associated:Human:Digestive system:Large intestine:Fecal, root:Environmental:Aquatic:Marine…) that every MGnify study is classified under. This is the lookup step before filtering studies or genomes by environment: the lineage strings are exact and are not guessable. Optionally narrow to one subtree by prefix.

lineage_prefix.description: Keep only lineages starting with this, e.g. "root:Host-associated:Human" or "root:Environmental".

name: mgnify_biomes
title: Mgnify Biomes
